SHOT: A worn photograph: the model's hand raised and resting lightly on her collarbone, the ring finger forward, the camera close enough that the ring is clearly legible. 4:5 vertical, full bleed.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: hand, fingers, wrist, collarbone and shoulder.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier photograph and the ONLY authority on what this piece is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; it is a shop photo of an open ring on pale satin: take only the ring with the gold heart and the pearl; ignore the satin and any second ring at the edge. IMAGE 2 is our approved packshot of this exact piece: the authority on its size, proportions, metal colour and finish; the piece in this picture must match it exactly. IMAGE 3 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn on the ring finger only; any other jewellery in IMAGE 3 is removed.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: AN OPEN TOI-ET-MOI RING: a slim plain polished gold band about 1.5mm wide that does NOT close; its two open ends meet side by side at the front: on one end a PUFFED solid polished gold HEART, smooth and domed, and on the other end ONE round lustrous white PEARL. Heart and pearl sit side by side, almost touching. Exactly one gold heart and one round white pearl; never two hearts, never a stone, never a halo; the band stays plain and slim.

SCALE TEST: On the finger the heart and the pearl together span about 13mm, never wider than the finger. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge.
